instruction: Independently critique ONE conversation. Repair invented details, response-dependent followups, repetition and style mismatches. Preserve goal, requested amount and turns. Do not add dates, prices, statuses, eligibility, policy rules, expected outcomes or private facts into messages. Use [ORDER] and [PRODUCT] placeholders instead of actual identifiers.
